name: Adam
summary: The first man, whom the LORD God made and placed in the garden of Eden. He and his wife ate from the one tree God had forbidden, and they were sent out of the garden.

key_moments.title: Naming the Animals
key_moments.description: The LORD God put the man in the garden of Eden to tend it. Then He brought every beast and bird to Adam, and whatever Adam called each creature became its name.

key_moments.title: A Wife from His Rib
key_moments.description: God put Adam into a deep sleep, took one of his ribs, and made a woman from it. Adam said she was made from his own bone and flesh, and called her Woman.

key_moments.title: Hiding Among the Trees
key_moments.description: The woman ate fruit from the forbidden tree and gave some to Adam, and he ate too. When the LORD God called to him, Adam said he had hidden because he was afraid and naked.

key_moments.title: Sent Out of Eden
key_moments.description: God told Adam the ground was cursed because of him, and he would work hard for his food until he returned to the dust. Then the LORD God sent him out of the garden of Eden.

key_moments.title: A Son Named Seth
key_moments.description: After Cain killed Abel, Adam and his wife had another son, Seth. Adam lived 930 years in all, and then he died.
